extra_vocab.en: the work of getting a product or system ready to use
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，setup instructions 是「安裝／設定說明」，客戶覺得很難照著做。這裡 setup 是名詞，用來修飾 instructions。

example.en: Different customers may need different setups for their home networks.
example.zh: 不同的客戶，家用網路可能需要不同的設定。

example.en: The setup instructions are included in the box.
example.zh: 設定說明就附在盒子裡。

example.en: The initial setup takes about ten minutes.
example.zh: 初始設定大約要十分鐘。

example.en: Many customers found the setup process confusing at first.
example.zh: 許多客戶一開始覺得設定流程很混亂。

example.en: Easy setup is one of the main selling points of this speaker.
example.zh: 簡易設定是這款喇叭的主要賣點之一。

examples.en: Our support team can help you finish the setup by phone.
examples.zh: 我們的客服團隊可以透過電話協助你完成設定。

examples.en: Several complaints were about the setup, not the sound quality.
examples.zh: 有幾件客訴是關於設定，而不是音質。

confusable.diff: set up 是動詞片語（兩個字）；setup 是名詞或形容詞（一個字）。
confusable.usage: 動詞要分開寫：You need to set up the speaker. 名詞才合在一起寫：The setup is easy.

example.en: Please set up the new printer before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 請在會議開始前設定好新印表機。

similar.diff: installation 指把軟體或設備「裝上去」；setup 還包含裝好後的設定與調整。

example.en: The installation of the software took about an hour.
example.zh: 軟體的安裝花了大約一小時。

similar.diff: configuration 較技術性，指設定各項參數；setup 較口語、範圍較廣。

example.en: The system configuration must match the customer's network.
example.zh: 系統設定必須符合客戶的網路。

example.en: Installation is free for orders over $500.
example.zh: 訂單超過五百美元可免費安裝。

example.en: The manual explains each step with clear pictures.
example.zh: 手冊用清楚的圖片說明每個步驟。

example.en: The setup of the new system took two days.
example.zh: 新系統的設定花了兩天。

example.en: We set up a hotline for customer questions.
example.zh: 我們設立了一條客戶諮詢專線。

extra_vocab.en: to change something to make it better or more correct
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，經理說如果客戶持續反映同樣問題，就請產品團隊「修改」說明書。revise 帶有「根據回饋改得更好」的意思，語氣正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: ask + 人 + to + V：ask the product team to revise the instructions，to 後面接原形動詞。

example.en: The product team revises the manual after every customer survey.
example.zh: 產品團隊在每次客戶調查後都會修改手冊。

example.en: The legal team revised the terms and sent them back.
example.zh: 法務團隊修改了條款並寄了回來。

example.en: I am revising the price list before tomorrow's meeting.
example.zh: 我正在明天的會議前修改價目表。

example.en: We had to revise the schedule after the supplier called.
example.zh: 供應商來電後，我們必須修改時程。

example.en: Please revise the draft and send it back by noon.
example.zh: 請修改草稿，並在中午前寄回。

example.en: The revised version of the guide is much easier to read.
example.zh: 指南的修訂版好讀得多。

example.en: The vendor agreed to revise the estimate downward.
example.zh: 廠商同意把估價往下修。

examples.en: We have revised the contract according to your comments.
examples.zh: 我們已依照你的意見修訂了合約。

examples.en: The company will revise its sales target next quarter.
examples.zh: 公司下一季會修訂銷售目標。

confusable.diff: review 是「檢視、審閱」，不一定要改；revise 是看過之後實際「動手修改」。

example.en: Please review the report first, then revise it if needed.
example.zh: 請先審閱報告，必要時再修改。

similar.diff: update 是把資料或內容「更新」到最新；revise 是修正錯誤或改善內容。

example.en: Please update the price list with the new rates.
example.zh: 請用新費率更新價目表。

similar.diff: amend 更正式，多用於合約、法規或文件的正式修正。

example.en: Both parties agreed to amend the contract terms.
example.zh: 雙方同意修正合約條款。

example.en: I will edit the document and send it to you.
example.zh: 我會編輯文件並寄給你。

example.en: The first draft of the manual is ready for review.
example.zh: 手冊的初稿已可供審閱。

example.en: Please use the latest version of the instructions.
example.zh: 請使用最新版本的說明書。

derived.link: revise 去掉 e 加 -ion，把「修改」變成名詞，像 decide → decision
